stage: locked-method conditional seed replication, not independent-data confirmation
primary_endpoint: paired G8-G1 final validation accuracy difference in percentage points across 20 seeds
primary_interval: two-sided 95% Student t paired interval with df19
accuracy_retention_gate: lower confidence limit strictly greater than -1.0 pp
required_checks: matched initial weights and explicit random streams
identical model parameter count and training budget
all fixed runs present, no unresolved algorithm failures
finite weights/states/predictions and no true-label input at evaluation
bootstrap: fixed 20000 paired seed resamples seed87123; sensitivity, not alternative favorable primary analysis
failure_policy: retain all data; no added seeds, group selection, checkpoint selection or margin relaxation
claim_boundary: Conditional seed variability on a reused fixed development dataset. No patient/population generalization, new algorithm, Dale/DP or whole-network locality claim.
sample_size_rationale: 20 prespecified pairs; planned SD1.5pp gives approximately0.70pp two-sided95% half-width, precision planning not guaranteed power
